changelog:
youtube-kol-scraper 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Scrapes YouTube by keyword to find and list creators (channel name, URL, video count, and most relevant video views)
- Extracts creator contact information: email (from description and linked sites) and social media links
- Supports basic channel info extraction and retrieves channel “About” data (country, join date, links)
- Includes step-by-step readiness checks for required tools and browser state before operation
- Provides clear API endpoints and extraction logic for search, pagination, and channel data
summary:
YouTube KOL info scraping: input search keyword → output creator list (channel name, URL, video count, most relevant video views, contact email/social links)
